**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met)** — no redline proposed.

Investigation summary:
- **p0206 / p0208 (Subparagraphs 12.20, 12.22)** — the planner's candidates are affirmatively permissive: any Party may sell IRUs or make Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "without any restrictions." Beneficial to us; not flagged.
- **p0227 (Subparagraph 17.4)** — pro-competitive obligation on Terminal Parties not to impede Direct Access; restrains counterparties, not us.
- **Negative searches** — "compete" returns only "competent tribunal/jurisdiction" (p0272, p0275); "exclusive" returns only the sole-and-exclusive dispute remedy (p0262); no hits for field-of-use, territory, resale prohibition, "shall be used only for", or "prohibited from engaging" language. The 25 "shall not" hits are all unrelated mechanics (confidentiality, liability, amendment, non-waiver, default).

The single preferred element — "Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction" — is already met on the document's face, so per the playbook this sits at the preferred position and is not redlined.
